quarterly_data.quarter: TSMC press release: Sony Semiconductor Solutions and TSMC Agreed to Establish (08-11-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Sony Semiconductor Solutions and TSMC executed a legally binding definitive agreement to establish Advanced Vision Semiconductor Manufacturing Corporation as a joint venture in Koshi City, Kumamoto Prefecture, Japan, as a core hub for the development and manufacturing required for volume production of image sensors for smartphones using advanced manufacturing process technology; the JV is expected to commence volume production in 2029. Sony will be the sole controlling shareholder (the JV is planned as a consolidated subsidiary of Sony Group) and plans to contribute approximately 465 billion yen through cash and the transfer of its newly constructed Koshi City fab; TSMC plans cash contributions of approximately 282 billion yen, to be made in phases based on market demand and other business conditions. Sony intends to lead core image sensor technology development, product planning and design, while the JV plans to leverage TSMC's advanced process technology and manufacturing expertise. Further investment for the planned production capacity is being considered on the premise of Japanese government support; the transaction is subject to regulatory approvals and customary closing conditions.
quarterly_data.figure: TSMC cash contributions approximately 282 billion yen; Sony approximately 465 billion yen; JV volume production expected in 2029
